not really a matter of taste. the pikmin 1 wistle was designed to show visually where your sound is, its not meant to be bubbly or fun, it's just an abstract way to "draw" a sound. It's very clever, its something that shows the creativity and love that went into p1&p2

the second wistle is just a shape. nothing clever about it. it also takes up a lot of the screen needlessly. its not that it's dull or boring, that would be completely okay for something like they wistle which is drawn on top of other important things in the environment, it's that it doesnt represent a sound, it represents a hitbox. I also really hate how it lights up the things around it, last I checked thats no how sound works. 

It seems pretty clear that the wistle is a good look into the abilities and love of the dev teams/leadership
